answer: In each epoch, an agent deposits bonded stake and proves membership in a Semaphore zero-knowledge tree while evaluating a committed epoch polynomial. RLN rate-limits messages by deriving a nullifier from the agent’s secret. If the same identity exceeds its quota, two polynomial shares expose the hidden Shamir secret, recovering the private key; the protocol then slashes collateral instantly. This mirror of accountability withstands a gale of Sybil identities, with atlas records preserving evidence.
